decisions.reason: The candidate already requires three perfect requalification clips; selecting one YouTube video as their shared source changes only the separate source-selection Requirement.
The one-video source rule applies to the new three-clip requalification batch, not the earlier 15-to-20-clip extended trial.
The source decision concerns the later requalification batch and does not retroactively change the completed initial trial.
The complete-teaching-moment standard is independently established by message 84 and is not changed by requiring all three clips to use one source video.
Message 84 does not modify or remove the existing effective-hook requirement.
The visual-editing changes in message 84 are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and are independent of the source-selection change.
The source decision does not mention or logically change caption color or presentation.
Requiring one shared source video does not change the existing 30-to-90-second duration range.
Message 84 reiterates the existing target of 125 approved clips per month without changing it.
